offers_products.reason: Main offering is an online insurance marketplace and lead-matching service, not goods or licensed software.

offers_services.reason: Matches shoppers with insurers and agents, providing customer acquisition and lead generation for P&C carriers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Consumers use the quote service free; carriers and agents are the paying buyers of leads and customers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Insurance carriers and local agents buy consumer leads, clicks and policy-sale referrals.

recurring_revenue.reason: Carriers and agents repeatedly buy leads and referrals through ongoing marketing relationships.

cyclical_demand.reason: Carriers' advertising and customer-acquisition spend can be cut quickly, as with other marketing budgets.

big_ticket.reason: Leads and referrals are small, frequent purchases bought continually by carriers and agents.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its data, AI matching technology and web platform, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Leading national insurance carriers are main customers, alongside thousands of local agents.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light online platform needing technology and marketing spend, not plants, fleets or properties.

notes: Consumers use the service free, so the consumer-buyer answer is a judgment call; carriers pay.
